issues.issue: This is a one-sided transfer: a transfer in with no sending fund. The report labels the same money as insurance proceeds on one page and as a transfer on another. It is in report_discrepancies but not in decision_needed. A person needs to decide whether this is a transfer or insurance revenue.

Under the user rule (2026-10-26/28), a capital outlay line should be labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' with the printed text in printed_label. Detail lines 7, 8, 17 and 18 (Capital improvements / Other capital outlay) were not relabelled.

The Golf Fund cost-type lines (disbursements 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20) have function culture/recreation. The rule for business-type cost-type lines says function 'utilities'. Culture/recreation is defensible for a golf course, but it is a judgment call.
